summary: Parked kerb near the road's east end, with flats about 12-20 m behind.

best_section.where: South kerb of Macquarie Street towards the east end, in front of the treed lawn

drivers.seclusion: Large apartment block set back behind trees, roughly 12-20 m from the kerb; flats and a car park across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb with cars already parked along it; room for a van in the line.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near its end; local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Cars park on both sides, so a van blends in; No Stopping signs only at the ends.

flags: Flats within about 10-20 m on own side
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, a mapped waterway 32 m away
Steepest 5 m step near the start reaches about 4.8%
No Stopping Any Time signs at the ends
sun_shade: Tree canopy overhangs the kerb from the south side; shaded in the morning from the building to the north.
